resources.string: If you allow, your phone asks to release the saved payment PIN for this site. Confirm it there.
Open the Kelo app on your phone to release the PIN “%1$s” once for the payment on %2$s (%3$s).
Payment PINs are kept only on your phone. Enter it in the Kelo app on your phone; this card closes by itself once it\'s saved.
Approve it in the card or bank app on your phone, then click “I approved it” here.
Click the code to copy it
Click the keys here. Each click goes to the same spot on the payment page.
The weather follows your phone\'s location. It shows up once you open Kelo on your phone and allow location.
Payment PINs are added in the Kelo app on your phone. They\'re locked with a key only that phone has.
